name: IoT Dashboard — N8N Snapshot Push (Single Webhook)

nodes.name: Webhook: IoT Snapshot
nodes.notes:
Single endpoint — Django pushes ALL events here
Set in .env: N8N_WEBHOOK_SNAPSHOT=http://YOUR_N8N:5678/webhook/iot-snapshot

nodes.name: Respond 200
nodes.notes: ตอบกลับ Django ทันที (non-blocking) ก่อน process ต่อ

nodes.name: LINE Notify — Critical 🚨
nodes.notes:
Credential: HTTP Header Auth
Authorization = Bearer <YOUR_LINE_TOKEN>

nodes.name: LINE Notify — Warning ⚠️
nodes.notes: Same LINE token — warnings only (not critical)

nodes.name: Google Sheets — Log Row
nodes.notes:
Logs every weather event (every 15 min) to Google Sheets
Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID

__meta._comment: === HOW TO USE — Single Snapshot Webhook ===
__meta._step1: N8N → Settings → Import Workflow → เลือกไฟล์นี้
__meta._step2: แก้ .env บน Django server:
__meta._step3: สร้าง LINE Notify credential ใน N8N (HTTP Header Auth): Authorization = Bearer <token>
__meta._step4: ถ้าใช้ Google Sheets: สร้าง credential และแก้ YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID
__meta._step5: Activate webhook node แล้ว restart Django

_payload_structure.trigger: sensor | relay | alarm | ai | weather  (what triggered this push)
_payload_structure.trigger_data: minimal data of the triggering event
_payload_structure.ai_latest: { decision, confidence_pct, reasoning_summary, relay_status, command_sent, timestamp }
_payload_structure.weather_latest: { city_name, temperature, feels_like, humidity, pressure, wind_speed, clouds, weather_main, weather_desc, rain_probability, aqi, aqi_label, pm2_5, pm10, timestamp }

_alert_routing.WARNING: rain≥70% or temp≥38°C or AQI≥4 or indoor overrange → LINE Notify
_alert_routing.INFO: relay change / AI decision → no notification (logged only)
_alert_routing.log_row: every weather trigger (15 min) → Google Sheets append
